kb_strategy_playbooks.title: Spot Grid Trading Strategy Playbook
kb_strategy_playbooks.summary: Arithmetic and geometric price band slicing to profit from sideways market volatility and oscillations.
kb_strategy_playbooks.content:
Spot Grid Trading operates by placing a ladder of alternating BUY (below market) and SELL (above market) limit orders across a defined upper and lower price corridor. When price dips, buy orders fill; as price bounces, the bot immediately registers a sell limit order at the higher grid level (buy price + grid spacing).
Key Mechanics:
- Arithmetic Spacing: Equal dollar/cent spacing between levels (e.g., $1.00, $1.10, $1.20).
- Geometric Spacing: Constant percentage spacing (e.g., 0.5% or 1.0% per grid level).
- Minimum Notional: Every order must strictly exceed exchange threshold ($5.00 on Binance/Bybit, $0.50 DEX).
- Profit Calculation: Grid Profit = (Grid Spacing % - (2 * Exchange Fee %)) * Investment per Grid.

kb_strategy_playbooks.title: Infinity Grid Bot Manual & Geometric Expansion
kb_strategy_playbooks.summary: Perpetual bullish grid that maintains a fixed total value of base crypto assets while locking in profits forever as price rises.
kb_strategy_playbooks.content: Infinity Grid has no upper ceiling limit. It keeps the total base asset holding value constant in USD terms. Whenever price rises by a set profit percentage (e.g., 0.75%), the bot sells the appreciated excess coin value into USDT. When price falls, it buys back to restore the constant base currency valuation. This eliminates the risk of running out of inventory in a parabolic bull run while compounding profits.

kb_strategy_playbooks.title: Safety-Order DCA & Martingale Strategy Playbook
kb_strategy_playbooks.summary: Multi-tier dollar cost averaging with price deviation multipliers and take profit on volume-weighted average entry.
kb_strategy_playbooks.content:
The Safety-Order DCA / Martingale strategy deploys a base order followed by escalating safety orders when price drops. Parameters:
- Price Deviation Scale: Geometric expansion of dip distances (e.g., 1.5x: -1%, -2.5%, -4.75%).
- Volume Multiplier: Scales order size (e.g., 1.5x or 2.0x) so average entry price rapidly approaches current market price.
- Take Profit Target: Closes entire position when market price reaches +1.5% above Volume Weighted Average Entry Price (VWAP).

kb_strategy_playbooks.title: SmartTrade Multi-Target Trailing Take Profit & Stop Loss
kb_strategy_playbooks.summary: Simultaneous Stop-Loss and Trailing Take-Profit execution with auto-break-even triggers.
kb_strategy_playbooks.content:
SmartTrade enables advanced spot and futures position management without exchange order locking restrictions.
- Multiple Take-Profit Targets: Target 1 (50% at +3%), Target 2 (30% at +6%), Target 3 (20% with Trailing TP at +10%).
- Trailing Stop-Loss: Activates when price reaches Target 1; moves stop loss to break-even entry price to guarantee zero-loss trade.
- Trailing Buy: Follows price downward during a dump and triggers market buy only when price bounces +0.5% off the bottom.

kb_strategy_playbooks.title: Threshold & Periodic Multi-Asset Rebalancing Playbook
kb_strategy_playbooks.summary: Maintains target portfolio weights across crypto and equity asset allocations.
kb_strategy_playbooks.content:
Automated portfolio rebalancing dynamically sells outperforming over-weighted assets to buy under-weighted assets.
- Threshold Rebalancing: Triggers rebalancing when any asset's actual portfolio weight deviates by >5% from target weight.
- Periodic Rebalancing: Executes scheduled rebalancing daily or weekly.
- Gas & Fee Optimization: Aggregates micro-rebalances into batch swaps to prevent fee erosion.

kb_rms_rules.title: Hard Portfolio Daily Drawdown Limit
kb_rms_rules.content: If portfolio equity declines by more than 10.0% within a rolling 24-hour window, the RMS engine instantly halts all active trading bots, cancels all open limit orders, and transitions system to PAUSED state. If daily loss breaches 15.0%, the emergency liquidator executes market sell on all spot/perp holdings.

kb_rms_rules.title: SEBI Peak Margin & Upfront Margin Requirement
kb_rms_rules.content: Per SEBI circular regulations, 100% of the VAR + ELM (Value at Risk + Extreme Loss Margin) must be collected upfront from clients for intraday equity and F&O positions. Clearing corporations take 4 random snapshots during market hours. Any leverage exceeding 1:1 against available collateral incurs peak margin penalty fines.

kb_rms_rules.title: SEC Regulation T & Pattern Day Trader (PDT) Limit
kb_rms_rules.content: Under SEC/FINRA Rule 4210 and Regulation T, margin accounts must maintain $25,000 minimum equity for Pattern Day Trading. Intraday day-trading buying power is capped at 4x the Maintenance Margin Excess, and overnight leverage is strictly 2x. If equity falls below $25,000, day trading is restricted to cash-only for 90 days.

kb_rms_rules.title: Exchange Spread Anomaly & Circuit Breaker Rule
kb_rms_rules.content: Detects flash crashes and market maker spread widening. If the bid-ask spread on any trading pair exceeds 2.5%, or if price moves >8% within a 60-second window, new order submission is blocked and a 15-minute cool-off period begins.

kb_broker_diagnostics.description: The Angel One SmartAPI JWT token has expired or is invalid.
kb_broker_diagnostics.root_cause: Angel One session tokens expire every 24 hours at 06:00 AM IST or after inactivity.
kb_broker_diagnostics.resolution_steps: 1. Call generateSession() using clientCode, MPIN, and TOTP key. 2. Store refreshed jwtToken and feedToken. 3. Retry rejected request.

kb_broker_diagnostics.description: Order rejected due to inadequate trading margin in account.
kb_broker_diagnostics.root_cause: Available margin balance is less than the calculated VAR+ELM requirement for the order quantity.
kb_broker_diagnostics.resolution_steps: 1. Fetch RMS margin summary. 2. Reduce order quantity to fit within available margin. 3. Cancel open pending buy orders to free blocked margin.

kb_broker_diagnostics.description: Upstox API v2 OAuth access token is expired.
kb_broker_diagnostics.root_cause: OAuth token validity exceeded (expires daily at 03:30 AM IST).
kb_broker_diagnostics.resolution_steps: 1. Trigger OAuth token refresh endpoint. 2. Update memory adapter token cache.

kb_broker_diagnostics.description: Order size is smaller than the minimum trade value ($5.00 USDT) or quantity precision violates stepSize.
kb_broker_diagnostics.root_cause: Bot placed micro order with quantity * price < 5.00 USDT or fractional decimals beyond stepSize filter.
kb_broker_diagnostics.resolution_steps: 1. Fetch exchangeInfo for symbol. 2. Verify minNotional and round down quantity to exact stepSize multiple. 3. If remaining balance < $5, skip order or perform auto-sweep.

kb_broker_diagnostics.error_name: Timestamp for this request was 1000ms ahead of the server's time
kb_broker_diagnostics.description: NTP clock drift between trading bot host machine and Binance matching engine.
kb_broker_diagnostics.root_cause: System clock is out of sync by >1000ms or network packet transmission delay exceeded recvWindow.
kb_broker_diagnostics.resolution_steps: 1. Call /api/v3/time to get server time. 2. Compute timeOffset = serverTime - localTime. 3. Include timeOffset in signature generation.

kb_broker_diagnostics.description: On-chain swap transaction reverted because minimum output amount was not met.
kb_broker_diagnostics.root_cause: AMM pool liquidity shifted or front-running / MEV sandwich bot caused price slippage beyond configured tolerance.
kb_broker_diagnostics.resolution_steps: 1. Re-quote swap route using Jupiter API v6. 2. Set dynamic slippage bps (50-100 bps). 3. Send transaction via Jito-Solana MEV protected bundle.

kb_broker_diagnostics.error_name: Recent Blockhash Not Found / Transaction Expired
kb_broker_diagnostics.description: Transaction was dropped before being confirmed into a Solana block.
kb_broker_diagnostics.root_cause: Solana network congestion caused the 150-slot validity window (~60s) of the blockhash to expire.
kb_broker_diagnostics.resolution_steps: 1. Fetch getLatestBlockhash('confirmed'). 2. Re-sign transaction. 3. Attach priority fee (ComputeUnitPrice) and resubmit.

kb_broker_diagnostics.description: Order value exceeds available cash and margin buying power.
kb_broker_diagnostics.root_cause: Account margin multiplier limit reached or funds held in unsettled trades.
kb_broker_diagnostics.resolution_steps: 1. Query /v2/account to check non_marginable_buying_power. 2. Resize order.

kb_indicators_ta.formula_or_logic: VWAP = Sum(Price * Volume) / Sum(Volume) computed cumulatively from session open.

signal_rules.bullish: Price breaks above VWAP with rising volume + retests VWAP as support.
signal_rules.bearish: Price breaks below VWAP with rejection from underside.

kb_indicators_ta.interpretation: Institutional benchmark for fair value. Trades executed above VWAP indicate buyer dominance; below VWAP indicate seller dominance.

kb_indicators_ta.formula_or_logic: RSI = 100 - (100 / (1 + RS)), where RS = Average Gain / Average Loss over 14 periods.

signal_rules.oversold_bounce: RSI crosses above 30 from below (Bullish Reversal).
signal_rules.overbought_rejection: RSI crosses below 70 from above (Bearish Rejection).
signal_rules.bullish_divergence: Price makes Lower Low while RSI makes Higher Low.

kb_indicators_ta.interpretation: Measures speed and magnitude of price movements to identify overbought/oversold conditions and trend exhaustion.

kb_indicators_ta.formula_or_logic: CVD = Cumulative Sum of (Aggressive Market Buy Volume - Aggressive Market Sell Volume).

signal_rules.absorption: Price makes new low while CVD is rising (Limit Buyers absorbing market sell orders).
signal_rules.exhaustion: Price makes new high but CVD fails to make higher high.

kb_indicators_ta.interpretation: Reveals aggressive market participant buying vs selling pressure and institutional limit order absorption.

kb_dex_onchain.title: Jupiter DEX Aggregator Multi-Hop Split Routing
kb_dex_onchain.content:
Jupiter aggregates liquidity across Raydium, Orca Whirlpools, Lifinity, Phoenix, and Meteora. It splits a single swap across multiple paths to minimize price impact on concentrated liquidity pools.
Execution Best Practices:
1. Dynamic Slippage: Calculate slippage based on pool TVL and price impact.
2. Priority Fees: Compute MicroLamports via getRecentPrioritizationFees.
3. MEV Protection: Direct bundle submission to Jito block engines (bundles.jito.wtf) with a 10,000 lamport tip.
kb_dex_onchain.code_sample: const quote = await jupiterQuoteApi.quoteGet({ inputMint, outputMint, amount, slippageBps: 50 });

kb_dex_onchain.title: Raydium CLMM (Concentrated Liquidity Market Maker) Mechanics
kb_dex_onchain.content: Raydium CLMM pools allocate liquidity within specific tick price ranges, achieving 1000x capital efficiency. When market price moves outside the active tick range, liquidity drops to zero and slippage spikes exponentially. Arbitrage bots must verify current tick and sqrtPriceX64 before routing swaps through CLMM pools.

kb_arbitrage_playbooks.title: Cross-Exchange Spatial Arbitrage Matching Playbook
kb_arbitrage_playbooks.transfer_delay_risk: Low (Zero on-chain transfer delay during trade execution due to pre-funded dual exchange balances).
kb_arbitrage_playbooks.content: Spatial arbitrage captures instantaneous price discrepancies between distinct centralized exchange order books. To eliminate blockchain transfer latency risk, accounts are pre-funded with USD/USDT and base crypto on both exchanges. The trade executes simultaneously as a BUY on the cheaper exchange and a SELL on the higher exchange.

kb_arbitrage_playbooks.title: Single-Exchange Triangular Arbitrage Loop
kb_arbitrage_playbooks.transfer_delay_risk: Zero (Executed atomically on same exchange engine).
kb_arbitrage_playbooks.content: Triangular arbitrage exploits pricing inefficiencies between 3 currency pairs on a single exchange. The triangular loop rate = (Price_BTC/USDT * Price_ETH/BTC) / Price_ETH/USDT. If Loop Rate > 1.0 + (3 * FeeRate), profit is locked without any cross-exchange transfer risk.

kb_fundamental_frameworks.title: Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Valuation Framework for NSE Bluechips
kb_fundamental_frameworks.summary: Multi-stage discounted cash flow model using Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) and terminal value.
kb_fundamental_frameworks.content: Projects 5-year unlevered free cash flows (FCFF = EBIT * (1 - Tax) + D&A - CapEx - Delta NWC) discounted by India cost of capital. Terminal value is calculated using Gordon Growth and Exit Multiple methods.

kb_fundamental_frameworks.title: Crypto Tokenomics, Staking Yield & Vesting Cliff Analysis
kb_fundamental_frameworks.summary: Valuation framework factoring circulating vs Fully Diluted Valuation (FDV), inflation schedule, and lockup unlocks.
kb_fundamental_frameworks.content: Analyzes token value accrual mechanisms: fee burns (EIP-1559 style), staking rewards, transaction fees, and imminent investor/team token unlocks that exert sell-side dilution pressure.
